# pi-glance 0.6.9

- `/glance` now uses one list across **Appearance**, **Status line**, and **Working**, with live preview.
- Set sweep speed from 10 to 120 columns per second. Both modes share the setting; the default stays at 47.
- Enter confirms field edits; Esc cancels them. Navigation is remembered, with confirmation before reset or discard.
- Less work per animation frame. Hidden previews stop animating.
- Keep complex characters intact when shortening workspace names, and guard against oversized Git timer settings.

Existing settings are kept. Config files change only when you save.

Tested with Pi 0.84.4 and 0.85.1 on Node.js 22.19.0 and 24.
